common.about_desc: Empowering education through seamless digital assessment workflows.
common.about_para: ExamSys is a premium, high-integrity online examination platform built to assist academic institutions in conducting safe, flexible, and automated tests. We bridge the gap between convenience and rigorous assessment metrics.
common.about_card1_desc: Instantly create exams, compile scores, and distribute performance diagnostics.
common.about_card2_desc: High-fidelity student performance analytics and grading systems for instructors.
common.about_card3_desc: Auto-save caches, connection integrity tracking, and strict anti-cheat policies.
common.contact_desc: Have questions? Send us a message and we'll get back to you shortly.

common.support_faq_q1: How do I start a scheduled exam?
common.support_faq_a1: Navigate to your student Dashboard, browse under the Available Exams list, and select Start Exam. Read the rules carefully before starting.
common.support_faq_q2: What happens if my connection drops mid-exam?
common.support_faq_a2: The system local-caches your responses automatically inside the browser cache. Once your internet connection restores, your progress updates and you can submit successfully.
common.support_faq_a3: Subjective exams containing text questions are reviewed and graded manually by your course instructor. Results will display as "Pending" until final grades are entered.
common.support_faq_q4: How can I change my profile name?
common.support_faq_a4: Go to the top-right user profile menu, select Settings, edit your name under the profile details tab, and click Save Changes.
common.support_ticket_msg_placeholder: Describe your issue with exact steps to replicate
common.support_ticket_success_toast: Support ticket submitted! We will contact you shortly.
common.terms_desc: Please read these terms carefully before using our platform.
common.terms_p1: By accessing and using the ExamSys examination system, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the application.
common.terms_p2: All examinations conducted through this platform are subject to strict academic integrity policies. Any attempt to cheat, share answers, utilize unauthorized materials, or bypass the application's environment will result in immediate disqualification and disciplinary action.
common.terms_p3: You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. ExamSys will not be held liable for any loss arising from unauthorized account access.
common.terms_p4: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the platform at any time, without prior notice, if we believe you are in breach of these Terms of Service.
common.privacy_desc: We value your privacy and are committed to safeguarding your personal data.
common.privacy_p1: We collect basic information required for educational administration, including your name, email, credentials, and course enrollments. Additionally, during exams, system telemetry, start/stop timestamps, and answers are saved to ensure integrity.
common.privacy_p2: Collected data is strictly used to compile grades, manage student enrollments, maintain test history, and prevent fraudulent actions during exam execution. We do not sell or trade user data to third-party advertisers.
common.privacy_p3: All database records are encrypted in transit and at rest. Access control policies ensure that student exam answers are only viewable by verified instructors and course administrators.
common.privacy_p4: We use cookies to maintain your login session. During exam taking, browser local storage is utilized to cache current selections to prevent progress loss from unexpected page reloads or network drops.

hero.headline: The Examination Platform Built for Academic Rigor
hero.subheadline: From question banks to instant results — ExamSys gives instructors complete control and students a calm, focused testing experience.

services.section_subtitle: Everything you need to deliver fair, high-stakes assessments or simple classroom quizzes.

card_1.title: Instructor Command Center
card_1.desc: Build and manage courses, exams, and question banks — all from one clean dashboard. Set passing scores, time limits, and publish with one click.

card_2.title: Intelligent Auto-Grading
card_2.desc: MCQ submissions graded instantly. Results available the moment time runs out — no waiting, no manual review.

card_3.title: Student-First Exam Experience
card_3.desc: Clean, distraction-free exam interface with question navigator, auto-save, and live countdown. Students stay focused — not frustrated.

card_4.title: Deep Analytics & Reports
card_4.desc: Per-exam performance breakdowns, pass/fail distribution, average score trends, and student progress over time.

card_5.title: Secure & Tamper-Resistant
card_5.desc: JWT-based auth, role-separated access, and question locking on published exams — academic integrity is always enforced.

card_6.title: Multi-Language & RTL Ready
card_6.desc: Runs in English, Arabic, Spanish, and French with automatic RTL layout switching — built to serve global campuses.

faq.a_1: Yes! Our Free plan includes everything you need to get started — 3 courses, 50 students, and basic analytics at no cost.
faq.a_2: When a student submits their exam (or time runs out), the platform instantly compares each selected answer to the correct choice and calculates the final score automatically.
faq.q_3: Can I customize passing score thresholds?
faq.a_3: Absolutely. When creating or editing an exam, you can set the exact passing score percentage for each exam individually.
faq.q_4: Does ExamSys support Arabic and RTL languages?
faq.a_4: Yes. The platform fully supports Arabic with automatic RTL layout switching. Spanish and French are also supported.
faq.a_5: Once an exam is published and has submissions, questions are automatically locked — preventing edits that could compromise grading fairness.
faq.q_6: Can students see their results immediately?
faq.a_6: Yes. For auto-graded exams, results are available the moment the submission is processed — typically within seconds.
faq.a_7: Yes. The entire platform is responsive and tested on mobile. Students can take exams from any device.
faq.q_8: How many students can enroll in one course?
faq.a_8: On the Free plan, up to 50 per course. Pro plan supports 500, and Enterprise is unlimited.
faq.q_9: Can I set a time limit on exams?
faq.a_9: Yes. You can configure time limits per exam. The student sees a live countdown, and the exam auto-submits when time expires.
faq.a_10: Click 'Get Started Free' at the top of this page, register an account, and you can create your first course in under 5 minutes.
